classification: Report per-original-row removal of variance and new variance. Sensitivity supports a retained-history mechanism only together with passive timeline showing old != incoming retained. No uniqueness or soundness inferred from row elimination.
purpose: Separate historical return retention from premature existence stubs and from join-law failure. Diagnostic intervention, not candidate repair.
self_check: Digests, diagnostics, reason counts and loop counts change by design. Original binary and inputs immutable. Invalid/timeout/repeat drift => no sensitivity result for that variant/app; otherwise row partitions are total.
settings: Campfire four v1a1 schedules before Forem, Chatwoot and Mastodon four v1a1 schedules. C is the new binary with both flags off, checked against native spine at unset on each app.

variants.H: Bypass only harvest informative_keep; all return handoff accumulation unchanged.
variants.R: Reference return handoffs publish current harvested value instead of joining previous return. Fold parameter and site slots unchanged.
